descriptions.w3d_cc28b_read_map_8018b9a0: Preserves negative base-reader errors. On success reads TextGroup and NumChars, retains replacement group before releasing prior group, frees and allocates the6-byte mapping array, reads Index/MappedVal/Unicode for each entry, releases the temporary held group, then returns zero. Typed native handle models observed lifetime; original class declaration/sizeof unknown.
